Implementation Details for Fourier Projection-Slice Volume Rendering
summary: This implementation generates volume renderings by exploiting the Fourier projection-slice theorem, using zero padding and tricubic interpolation to reduce per-view complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2 log N).
